data.title: Binance Lists First BEP2 Community Listing Project - Ankr (ANKR)
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

Binance began a new initiative last month to support the development of high quality blockchain projects in the industry and to list at least one project from Binance DEX on Binance.com each month over 3 months.

For the first BEP2 community listing program, there were 6 candidates that met the requirements: ANKR, AWC, BOLT, LTO, RAVEN and SPNDB. In selecting the winning project, factors considered included authenticity of trading volume on Binance DEX, tight bid/ask spread on each trading pair, depth of order book on Binance DEX, as well as various other factors.

We would like to congratulate ANKR for being selected as the first BEP2 community listing project. 

Projects that were not selected this time are still eligible to participate in next month’s BEP2 community listing program.

Binance will list Ankr (ANKR) and open trading for ANKR/BNB, ANKR/BTC, ANKR/USDT, ANKR/PAX, ANKR/TUSD and ANKR/USDC trading pairs at 2019/07/23 2:00 PM (UTC). Users can now start depositing ANKR in preparation for trading.

ANKR Listing Fee: 0 BNB. 

Note:

  • Binance is listing the BEP2 version of ANKR as the default token. Users will only be able to withdraw the BEP2 version of ANKR tokens. 
  • You may deposit ERC20 ANKR tokens to your Binance account by depositing to your ETH deposit address.
  • The ANKR token asset page is available on the Binance Chain explorer here https://explorer.binance.org/asset/ANKR-E97 .
  • ANKR mainnet tokens will not be accepted for deposits/withdrawals. 

For further details on this initiative, please refer to Binance.com Launches BEP2 Community Listing Program.

To learn more about the Ankr (ANKR) project, read our in-depth Binance Research Report here.

Details:

  1. About Ankr (ANKR)
  2. Fees
  3. Rules

Risk warning: Cryptocurrency investment is subject to high market risk. Please make your investments cautiously. Binance will make best efforts to choose high quality coins, but will not be responsible for your investment losses.

Thanks for your support!

Binance Team

2019/07/23

 

Find us on

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/binance 

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/binance
